chunks: What al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from al-Ḥasan, from Zurʿah, from Samāʿah, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever has preserved awareness of his forgetfulness and then completes it, there are no two sajdahs of forgetfulness upon him. For indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم led the people in the ẓuhr prayer, then forgot and gave salām. Dhū al-Shimālayn said to him, “O Messenger of Allah, has something been revealed concerning the prayer?” He said, “And what is that?” He said, “You only prayed two rakʿahs.” So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said, “Do you say the like of what he says?” They said, “Yes.” Then he stood and completed the prayer with them, and performed the two sajdahs of forgetfulness.

He said: I said, “What do you see regarding one who prayed two rakʿahs, then thought they were four, so he gave salām and departed, then remembered after he had gone that he had only prayed two rakʿahs?” He said: “He begins the prayer again from its beginning.”

He said: I said, “Then why was it that the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم did not begin the prayer again, and only completed with them what remained of his prayer?” He said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم had not left his place. So if he has not left his place, then let him complete what is lacking from his prayer.”

key_terms.سَجْدَتَا ٱلسَّهْوِ: the two prostrations performed for forgetfulness in salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَسَلَّمَ: he concluded the salat (prayer) with salām
key_terms.مَا نَقَصَ: what was omitted or lacking from the salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَجْلِسِهِ: his place or sitting position after the salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَسْتَقْبِلُ ٱلصَّلَاةَ: he starts the salat (prayer) anew from the beginning

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets part of the prayer and remembers later, should they complete it or restart the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the ruling of forgetfulness in salat (prayer), especially when a person omits part of the prayer and then remembers. It distinguishes between one who remains in place and completes the missing portion, and one who has already departed, in which case he restarts the prayer. It also cites the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم as precedent regarding completion of the prayer.
